channels.name: TX+ / TX- (per phy)
channels.purpose: Outbound differential NRZ serial data of the phy.

channels.name: RX+ / RX- (per phy)
channels.purpose: Inbound differential NRZ serial data of the phy.

channels.name: Wide port (phys sharing a SAS address)
channels.purpose: Aggregates multiple phys with the same SAS address for bandwidth and redundancy.

global_signals.name: SAS address (64-bit)
global_signals.purpose: Worldwide-unique port identifier; matches source/destination in the OPEN address frame.

global_signals.name: Connection
global_signals.purpose: A dedicated full-duplex path opened between two ports.

global_signals.name: SAS domain
global_signals.purpose: The set of devices and expanders interconnected through the topology.

handshake_pairs.name: OOB
handshake_pairs.rule: COMINIT/COMSAS/COMWAKE detect attachment and distinguish SAS from SATA.

handshake_pairs.name: Speed Negotiation Window
handshake_pairs.rule: Negotiate the highest common link rate.

handshake_pairs.name: OPEN / OPEN_ACCEPT
handshake_pairs.rule: OPEN address frame requests a connection; OPEN_ACCEPT opens it, OPEN_REJECT denies it.

handshake_pairs.name: RRDY
handshake_pairs.rule: Grants one frame of credit (flow control).

handshake_pairs.name: ACK / NAK
handshake_pairs.rule: Acknowledges or rejects an SSP frame (NAK -> retransmit).

dependency_graph.common_rule: A phy must complete OOB (COMINIT/COMSAS/COMWAKE) + the Speed Negotiation Window + dword synchronization before any connection. A connection must be open (OPEN address frame -> AIP -> OPEN_ACCEPT) before SSP/STP/SMP frames flow; expanders route the OPEN frame by SAS address using the expander route table.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: An SSP frame requires: (1) the phy synchronized, (2) a connection open to the destination SAS address, (3) RRDY credit granted; each SSP frame is CRC-checked and ACK/NAKed. Rate matching (ALIGN) couples a slower connection rate to a faster physical link rate.

power_pins.name: VCC (HBA)
power_pins.purpose: Core / IO supply for HBA silicon.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Differential NRZ serial; 8b10b/128b150b dwords; ALIGN dwords keep synchronization.
ordering_rules.connection_order: Connections are opened by arbitration (arbitration wait time) and torn down by CLOSE/BREAK/DONE.
ordering_rules.wide_port: A connection may use any phy of a wide port; phys share the SAS address.
ordering_rules.transport: SSP, STP, and SMP frames are carried inside their respective connections.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Idle / ALIGN dword
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Link synchronized but no frame in flight between connections.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active connection
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: A connection is open; SSP/STP/SMP frames flow full-duplex.
